decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures the confirmation-email information required by the new fiat-buyer rewards FAQ; the certificate reading actions require no additional FAQ-state change.
The existing message-184 INTRODUCE fully captures the optional offline PDF link, its label, and its presentation on the email certificate.
The confirmation-certificate email changes do not alter the About page, and the incidental reuse of the ebook title does not require a content update.
The existing message-184 INTRODUCE already records read-only default behavior, PDF.js, and the dashboard and email-certificate entry points.
Prize-winner email notification is a separate clause already captured by the candidate's message-184 INTRODUCE; changing the mint confirmation certificate adds no further notification requirement.

The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures wallet provisioning, holdings, mint destination, and email-linked or SIWE dashboard access; the certificate reading actions do not further change wallet provisioning.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures Transak's conversion-and-mint behavior, while the confirmation email's ebook actions do not alter the fiat mint flow.
The existing message-184 MODIFY already captures SIWE with the Transak-created wallet as a dashboard-access alternative; the certificate reading link does not change authentication semantics.

The candidate already has message-184 events resolving payout to automatic direct wallet transfer and removing the claim interaction; the confirmation-certificate changes add no further payout-state change.
The confirmation email's mint-number and ebook-access information does not change which NFT state transfers on a secondary sale.
The source leaves the $15 price, $5 referral commission, founder allocation, and prize-pool funding unchanged; email content does not affect revenue allocation.
The source restates the existing automatic $5 referral commission only as explanatory FAQ content and does not change its amount, trigger, recipient, timing, or payout mode.
